summary: Iron Mountain Incorporated filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of $1.5 billion in 6.250% Senior Notes due 2035 at par, used to repay revolving credit facility borrowings. This is a routine debt financing event, not a special situation, as it represents ordinary refinancing for general corporate purposes. No special-situation elements such as change of control, restructuring, or strategic shift are present. The filing triggers no special-situation classification under typical event-driven analysis.
